description: Addressing Short- and Long-Term Risks to Water Supply is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by City of Fredericktown Water Plant; EPA Creating Resilient Water Utilities Program. In 2012, water managers in Fredericktown, Missouri, saw their city's main source of water dwindle. They used the EPA’s Creating Resilient Water Utilities program to consider options and develop plans to protect their water source. Coverage: Missouri (2015). The toolkit gives Missouri as the location, 2015 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
